authority.scope: Research, source acquisition, reversible implementation candidates, tests, draft changes and raw evidence publication within existing authorization.

current_operational_boundary.private_production_checkpoint: PR190 accepted release supersedes historical PR178/189 integration status; refresh exact operation receipts before relying on the runtime.

cycle_policy.analogy_rule: Use a useful unconventional analogy with an explicit invariant, counterexample and translation-back test; do not force it.
cycle_policy.browser_limits: Use installed bounds and resource-headroom/deadline admission; this program does not increase them.
cycle_policy.deadline_rule: Admit only work that fits the actual remaining cycle and operation deadlines; checkpoint before exhaustion. This configuration does not itself enforce a host process deadline.
cycle_policy.ideonomy_trigger: Only a named blockage, unexplained observation, design trade-off or search gap; require compatible typed primitives and report unexamined combinations.
cycle_policy.notification_rule: Notify for a tested improvement, meaningful negative finding, concrete new blocker or necessary specification request; otherwise persist a checkpoint without repetitive notifications.
cycle_policy.selection: Resume the latest unfinished checkpoint; choose the next measurable bottleneck and rotate among ready tracks without dropping unresolved hypotheses.
cycle_policy.source_access: Preserve site controls, anonymous isolation, network policy and denied/failed retrieval evidence.
cycle_policy.source_scope: General public databases, primary papers, official software/science repositories, relevant GitHub sources and news as discovery leads; no source-domain allowlist imposed by this program.
upstream_watch: NASA public software and relevant public scientific repositories

direction_source.text: Allow Merlin to continuously improve while learning and designing systems, technology, Parallax chips, better mathematics and Xenomaths, using n-ality, simplex, glyphs and related tools; continue from the retained checkpoint.

evidence_contract.failure_policy: Retain the baseline if no candidate passes; preserve dissent, abstentions, regressions and failed hypotheses.
evidence_contract.heldout_policy: Freeze versioned disjoint reference/training and fresh held-out fixtures; do not tune to held-out outcomes or infer semantic independence from disjoint IDs alone.
evidence_contract.learning_claim_rule: Accumulated context, a new draft, browser navigation, a schedule, or a passing local test does not establish trained weights or general autonomous improvement.
evidence_contract.publication_rule: Use the existing connected repository/draft workflow under standing authorization; exclude credentials and unrelated personal data.
retain_raw: artifact byte lengths and SHA-256 digests

integration_contract.fallback: If the accepted installed browser/request route is unavailable, continue independent work through connected read-only research sources and record the exact unavailable step.
integration_contract.interruption_rule: status/read retrieves existing publication or failure; reconciliation_needed must never become implicit resubmission.
integration_contract.query_and_http_source_rule: Keep exact acquisition URLs and all canonical observation refs. Bridge only eligible actual HTTPS query-free captures; retain explicit intake status for other URLs.
integration_contract.remaining_composition: An explicitly packaged/authorized same-project plan writer and bounded coordinator are required before claiming end-to-end runtime research composition.

purpose: Continue scientific, mathematical, engineering-design and agent-software research through bounded evidence-preserving cycles.

required_representation_checks.n_ality_scope_distinction: Current geometric/state/channel/temporal signature is separate from broader n-ary and group/representation-theoretic research.

acceptance: Requirements and failure conditions are explicit.
Units, frames, interface and connectivity invariants survive any transformation.
Retain independent numerical or engineering checks and failed outcomes.
tracks.definition: Translate a stated engineering need into explicit requirements, typed geometry/connectivity or software architecture, units, interfaces, constraints, testable models, and reproducible design artifacts.
limits: A diagram, CAD export, netlist, or synthetic simulation is not fabrication sign-off.
Historical tools or PR references do not prove current installation.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Select one documented design bottleneck and compare a bounded candidate against an exact baseline and independent reference; verify tool installation before selecting CAD, SPICE, or other domain execution.
tracks.title: Systems and technology design

acceptance: Exact KCL, electrical-power and thermal-balance invariants for the rational finite-network references.
Independent assembly and reconstruction of the actual pinned CACE residual and manufactured-solution errors.
For the historical P1 contract, nodal agreement and both algebraic residual checks are at most 1e-7; preserve the exact geometry and source pin.
Report continuum discretization error separately from algebraic solver residual; retain mutation controls and mesh coverage.
tracks.definition: Recover and assess the existing synthetic exact-network electrothermal, mesh-refinement, P1 manufactured-Poisson, and full-square variable-material references before proposing equivalent experiments.
limits: Historical chip files are absent from the saved current-main snapshot.
The full-square reference explicitly reports no actual CACE variable-coefficient execution.
Synthetic material data, virtual resource budgets, and finite meshes are not calibrated silicon, transistor transport, a foundry PDK, a continuum certificate, or fabrication qualification.
Do not rerun old workflows or unavailable Avrea work without a fresh authorized resource admission.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Reconcile the recovered exact files with current CACE interfaces and a reproducible local fixture; the historical missing integration is actual pinned variable-coefficient/nonconstant-forcing assembly, not another invention of the already recovered square reference.
tracks.title: Chip electrothermal and manufactured PDE research

acceptance: Each candidate states mathematical semantics, assumptions and an observable or falsifier.
Coordinate or representation changes preserve stated invariants and pass a translation-back test.
Novelty is assessed against actual searched sources and never inferred solely from an absent ledger entry.
tracks.definition: Typed exploration of mathematical objects, operators, relations, invariants, dimensions, bases, coordinate systems and possible compositions.
limits: The standalone original Xenomaths/SOM-X specification was not recovered.
The broad typed object/coordinate registry remains a program proposal; bounded enumeration is narrower.
No numerical experiment or generated conjecture is labeled a universal theorem.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Choose one named mathematical gap; declare typed primitives, compatible relations, source-backed assumptions and a falsifying check; run a bounded enumeration and preserve rejected and unexamined scope.
tracks.title: Xenomaths and typed mathematical exploration

acceptance: Parsing and normalization have explicit inputs, outputs and malformed-input behavior.
Rewrite steps preserve declared type and semantic invariants.
Confluence and termination claims match the actual checked scope.
Rendering and simulation preserve mathematical meaning and offer a symbolic/text representation.
tracks.definition: Explicit grammar, parser, normalizer, typed glyph objects and rewrite rules, with confluence/termination obligations and declared multi-frame rendering or simulation semantics.
limits: No named XMG/glyph engine files were found in the saved current-main tree.
A historical PR72 reference alone does not verify an engine or installation.
A rendered glyph or diagram is not proof of the represented claim.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Recover any exact existing engine before implementation; otherwise prepare one small typed grammar and normalization/rewrite fixture as a reviewable proposal with a termination measure and critical-pair or counterexample checks.
tracks.title: Glyph Foundry and XMG

acceptance: Every typed plan contains simplex, n_ality, continuum and fuzzy_logic decisions.
Each decision has a reason, invariant/test and limits/unknowns.
Keep four-axis n-ality distinct from broader group/representation-theoretic questions.
tracks.definition: Assess all four representations in every typed plan and apply only those justified by the problem, with explicit invariants, tests and limits.

implemented_scope.continuum: Bounded piecewise-linear interpolation with 2-128 samples on [0,1]; not a general PDE solver.
implemented_scope.fuzzy_logic: Explicit ramp membership and min/max aggregation; membership is not probability or authorization.
implemented_scope.n_ality: Separate geometric, state, logical-channel and temporal dimensions; not a general n-ary engine.
implemented_scope.simplex: 2-16 unit-interval weights summing to one and bounded convex mixtures; no affine-independence certificate.

limits: The C++ continuum_simplex.hpp path mentioned by a helper was not recovered in current source.
Fuzzy scores never relax Boolean permissions, evidence requirements or qualification.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Use the lens that addresses the selected problem and add the smallest original-task test for the preserved invariant; record not_applicable or deferred when justified.
tracks.title: Simplex, n-ality, continuum and fuzzy methods

acceptance: Bind the exact recovered specification and distinguish its stated claims from measured results before proposing architecture-specific work.
tracks.coverage: No Parallax architecture/specification/experiment was found in the searched local text/source or the two focused Personal Context lookups reported by the coordinating agent.
limits: Do not invent a Parallax architecture or equate the name with a commercial Propeller processor.
The absence result covers the searched material, not all possible private or historical sources.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Locate the user-provided architecture, source document, repository or experimental record; retain the gap and advance other concrete tracks while it is unavailable.

acceptance: Exact request, source commit, artifact identity, action trace, observations, failure records and plan revision survive restart.
Existing durable intent yields replay/readback or explicit reconciliation, never an implicit repeated effect.
No claim of improved capability without an independent baseline comparison and held-out result.
tracks.definition: Connect accepted source acquisition to typed plans, canonical branch-session outcomes, independent checks and exact-parent plan revisions through already authorized interfaces.
limits: The recurring task is not a deployed perpetual daemon.
Browser submit/status/read does not grant arbitrary registry writes.
The old private service and the browser research registry remain separate.
tracks.next_measurable_step: Verify native browser and connected request acceptance, then complete one bounded source-to-plan/review handoff using an explicitly authorized same-project writer; do not imply the composition is already deployed.
